title: Father's guitar, mattress making, and brother Sam the drummer
summary: His father played guitar and made mattresses; oldest brother Sam was a drummer who no longer plays.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did you have, did your father play?
My father played guitar years back in the old-own Seminard Parish. The old guitar player, but he left and his main occupation was mattress making, self-employed.
Same as Milly Barnes and mattress making. And I first started that when I was a young boy and pick up the drums through the old-time Grafianolas. My oldest brother was a drummer, Sam Fraser.
He lives at 1717 Fostyle Street. Him and...
